run_encode_densepose_results: run the script to encode dense human pose estimation results from a pickle file into a packed JSON file using PNG compression
encode_png_data: encode a 3D uint8 numpy array of shape (3, M, N) into a base64-encoded PNG-compressed string
save_png_json: load a pickle file of dense pose results, encode each UV array as PNG, and save the packed data to a JSON file
parse_arguments: parse command line arguments for the input pickle results file and output JSON packed file paths
status_str: generate a progress bar string showing the current percentage of items processed out of a total
